evidence.text: Kyndred is developing AI companions with voice, memory and real-time interaction, aiming to provide users with a more consistent way to navigate AI and receive support with everyday tasks.

Cancel any time in the app. No checkout here: you pick a plan in the app, only if you want to. Start free Before you start . Is it really free? Yes. No card and no trial. New accounts get free energy every day, and it refills daily. Pay only if you want more. How far does the free energy go? About 100 messages a day, or about 10 spoken replies on a voice call. Voice uses more because every reply is spoken, and a longer reply uses a little more. The app shows your energy as a percentage, and when it refills. What do plans cost? Plus is $9.99 a month, Pro $19.99, Max $39.99. Plus and Pro multiply your daily energy: 5x or 10x. Max is unlimited for personal use. Plus adds send photos they can see. Pro adds camera, screen sharing, and watch & play. Cancel any time. Can I talk out loud? Yes. Tap call and talk. Each character answers in their own voice, in real time. Your browser will ask for the microphone once. Will they remember me? Yes. Each character keeps their own memory of you across conversations. You can read, edit or clear what they remember. Is it private? We don't sell your data, and we don't use your conversations to train AI models. You can delete your account and everything in it from Settings. How far can it go? Characters can flirt, but the ceiling is 16+ and nothing gets explicit. Are they real people? No. Every character is an AI, and what they say is fiction.
